title: data/rfem.json -- the `rfem` domain: one instance per structure of an RFEM model
description: What the solver found on the bars of each named structure, as a calculation domain of the shape section 3.3 defines, so that #val, #find, #show-calc and the summary tables read it with nothing added. A file of its own, as a connector's and a connection's are: it is exported on its own and belongs to no position. Generated by calc/domains/rfem.py from the design situations' own envelope tables -- nothing here is computed, and every var names the combination that produced it.

cases.description: RFEM's own load cases, by id: CC1 is «EG + AL». What lets a combination's formula be printed with the names instead of the ids.

combinations.description: RFEM's own load combinations, by id, each with the factors and cases it is built from -- read, never recomposed.

structures.description: By structure id -- the @model name the engineer typed into RFEM, which is what a report addresses it by.

export.description: The RFEM export this structure was read from, as the project names it.

engine.description: A fourth engine beside excel, python and norm: the numbers are a solver's.

id.description: T001_1 -- the position and its index among that position's members here. Always indexed, so a call that is right today stays right when a second member of that position joins.

position.description: The position the member's comment names, or empty.

situations.description: The design situations read, by their own id: {"SP1": "SP1 - ELU Type 2 - Fondamental"}.

zero.description: Per bar, the quantities that are identically zero on it and are therefore left out of vars -- a plane model carries no V_y, M_T, M_z, u_y, phi_x or phi_z at all. Named so that 'this structure has no M_z' and 'this export was read without M_z' stay two different statements.

vars.description: By name, <situation>_<bar>_<quantity>_<kind>: SP1_T001_1_M_y_max. The situation is in the name because the engineer asked that one always state which situation is being looked at, and one instance per structure means a bar holds one maximum per situation.

loading.description: The load combination that produced this extreme -- RFEM's own answer, read and not enveloped here.

at.description: Where along the member it is, in metres; absent for a support reaction.

steps.description: A structure carries no working: its numbers are read from a solver, not derived here.
